symptom: Header click changed URL but Home content sometimes remained until hard refresh

rootCause.primary: Missing page remount key + no ChunkLoadError / routeChangeError recovery; stale Component tree could remain mounted after failed client transition
contributing: Nested react-router-dom BrowserRouter wrapping Next App (_app-full.tsx) — retained for legacy Farms/Pools RR routes but hazardous with Next history
Mobile bottom nav used plain <a> instead of next/link
SuspenseWithChunkError existed but was not mounted
notPrimary: Header already used next/link (not shallow routing for primary items)

fixes: Component key={routeKey} from router.asPath pathname in _app-full.tsx
useRouteTransitionRecovery on routeChangeError for ChunkLoadError reload
Header NavLink onClick → router.push (preventDefault) for primary items
